purpose: Clear blue sky over the bay, with sparse soft clouds and shared HDR radiance in sky, water and PBR reflections. Lighting reference, not a photograph of Shenzhen.

runtime.radiance: Unclipped linear HDR. The unblurred cube level supplies the visible sky; roughness-prefiltered levels supply PBR reflections and diffuse irradiance.
runtime.solarDirection: Sampled source solar-disc direction in Babylon cube space, transformed by inverse environment rotation. Not astronomical simulation.
runtime.controls: cinematic.setMode('day'); setNight(true/false) remains compatible for night/sunset.

validation.source: Downloaded bytes and MD5 match official metadata; local SHA-256 recorded; HDR decoded as 4096x2048.
validation.visualSource: Official panorama reviewed against Kloppenheim 05: predominantly clear blue upper sky, sparse soft clouds and low cloud band; no imported buildings or mountains.
validation.integratedVisual: Current build reviewed in output/playwright/coastal-sky/after: three daytime sky directions, open sea blue reflection, high coast in daylight and sunset, and night mode cycle. Browser errors 0; the 1080p high coast and daytime seaside 10-second samples were both about 60 FPS.
